summary.zh-CN: Panel App 的主侧栏管理现在在列表、运行态和左侧入口中保持一致，并可直接从左侧移除。
summary.en-US: Panel App main-sidebar management is now consistent across the list, running view, and pinned entry, with direct removal from the left sidebar.

title.zh-CN: Panel App 入口可以就近管理
title.en-US: Manage Panel App entries where you use them

body.zh-CN: 在 Panel Apps 列表、右侧运行态或左侧主侧栏中都能使用同一组添加与移除操作；左侧入口悬停后可以直接移除，当前 App 页面不会被关闭。
body.en-US: Use the same add and remove action from the Panel Apps list, the running view, or the left main sidebar. Hover a pinned entry to remove it without closing the current App page.

title.zh-CN: 恢复的快捷入口仍可管理

body.zh-CN: 从旧会话或恢复状态打开的 Panel App 也会正确识别应用身份并显示主侧栏操作。
body.en-US: Panel Apps reopened from older sessions or restored state now resolve their identity correctly and expose the main-sidebar action.
